source.where: games.fun research/studio-v2/evals/cases/T5.json (frozen 2026-10-10): the creator's prompt, verbatim, the one they named as the bridge to cross

prompt: Build a minecraft based world where we attack giants by swinging through the air with swords

ledger.means: The world is built of blocks (ground, cliffs, trees, buildings) whose faces stay crisp near, far and at speed
Players fly by swinging: hooks fired at the world, a rope that swings them; chained swings cross the map without touching the ground
Players strike with swords from the air; a strike at speed hurts a giant, and a giant can be killed
The enemies are giants, many times a player's height, more than one, and they come at the players
Friends attack together in one game
The players' characters are block-built too and match the world

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

policy: Nothing on screen names or copies the named block game or any other franchise: the block look is ours

control.text: The game includes a working fishing minigame
